contract.purpose: Validate MAGRA as a comfortable beta tool for real pet-project development workflows.
contract.scope: Disposable project scenarios, runtime smoke, web chat MyGRACE calls, RTK shell behavior, SNARC recall across restart, and friction reporting.

interfaces.interface-2: scripts or deterministic smoke tests for disposable pet-project flows

invariants.invariant-1: Dogfooding records exact commands, outcomes, failures, and friction.
invariants.invariant-2: At least three pet-project scenarios are exercised before beta readiness is claimed.
invariants.invariant-3: Failed or awkward workflows become tracked follow-up items.
